title: CAGE-2 bounded defence task
description: Evaluate a selected blue policy against one declared CAGE-2 red variant on the packaged synthetic topology.

evaluation_protocol.intent: Retain the source-projected blue reward as bounded portable evidence without exporting native state.

cage2-cumulative-blue-reward.name: Cumulative blue reward
cage2-cumulative-blue-reward.measured_construct: Sum of admitted source reward components projected for the blue participant.

intended_use: Run an installed-adapter smoke episode or the declared two-seed study.
non_use: Do not treat this synthetic example as an outcome-equivalence benchmark.
population_or_construct: A synthetic single-host private network under the qualified CAGE-2 source mapping.

split_and_leakage_controls.partitioning_strategy: Fixed public synthetic topology; hidden native truth is never exported.

notes: Requires the separately installed qualified CybORG source and the cyborg-cage2 backend.

validity_notes.note: The packaged topology is intentionally small and supports workflow validation, not broad empirical claims.
